Hello all, is it planned to link the precompiled binaries in the repo: https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-deposit-cli/releases/tag/v0.2.1 to the launchpad? As an easier option in case some faces an issue with python :). yes, it is planned. the lead dev on that repo is on holiday this week (yes, not great timing 😅 ) I expect there to be something on that next week <@!291925846556540928> thank you! There is a bug in the launchpad. If you for example want to setup 2 validators but only make the deposit in one of them and later click continue, the next page says that you have deposited 64 GoETH instead only 32. Not sure where or to who report this. Maybe some of the prysm devs know Please report issues to https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-deposit Thank you! Done, thanks! I did a write up of the genesis process for Eth2, focusing on Medalla. Turns out that there's lot of confusion about this, including with me 😂 https://hackmd.io/@benjaminion/genesis Hi guys, i am trying to do the medalla setup? after running "sh deposit.sh" my console stops afte "Type the password that secures your validator keystore(s):" I gave the password and pressed enter but nothing happes appreciate your help i am following the window setup on my pc > I did a write up of the genesis process for Eth2, focusing on Medalla. Turns out that there's lot of confusion about this, including with me 😂 https://hackmd.io/@benjaminion/genesis <@!573787335796326400> Nice write-up. Note that any deposits in blocks after the block in which the 16384th deposit is made will enter the queue, so anyone depositing now won't be a genesis validator but will go through the queue process the same way as someone that deposits after genesis (albeit further ahead in the queue) not true! actually not true 🙂 confusion indeed they will still be included yeap , I learnt it the hard way 🙂 the first block to hit all the conditions is the block that decides the genesis state "all the conditions" meaning the timestamp (plus genesis delay) hits min_genesis_time and the total deposits hit the min_active_validator_count the block needs to satisfy the 2 genesis conditions, once that is satisfied all deposits till the eth1block are included in the genesis state As evidence, Altona had min validators set to 640, but we ended up with 685 in the genesis state (I think all active - need to double chexk!). Ooh, thought that anything beyond the "genesis" eth1 block was added to the queue. Will have to go and re-read. So genesis validators can be any number >16384, as long as they get in in time? Interesting. yeap, pretty much We've setup some Prysmatic labs bootnodes for Medalla. PR has the ENRs: https://github.com/goerli/medalla/pull/32 so in altona we had people running a validator then losing interest - in part, I'd think that this is because it's not really well documented anywhere how to _stop_ being a validator - ie launchpad doesn't seem to mention it. <@!449019668296892420> Agreed. You have to really dig in to find out that it's possible to do a voluntary exit, dig in more to find out that you can't reenter until phase 1 and no instructions how to actually do it. We don't actually support voluntary exit yet on Teku. I mean, why would anyone want to stop using Teku 😛 It's Python, does it not run already run on ARM? Otherwise you can also use ethdo to generate keys, that definitely compiles on ARM I guess this will come before mainnet, but you could file an issue there so it doesn't get forgotten still showing 545 open slots for validators or am i wrong? that looks like negative validators left meaning we have 545 more than the minimum required ah, nice, thanks for explaining (hopefully its the correct answer!) > (hopefully its the correct answer!) <@!178943358755012608> it is fix soon 😅
